checks.name: sqlfluff
checks.protects: SQL that breaks the rules of the database type set as dialect in the project's .sqlfluff file.
checks.misses: Whether a migration is safe on a live table, and whether the SQL does what was meant.

checks.name: squawk
checks.run: if [ ! -f .sqlfluff ]; then echo "squawk: .sqlfluff is missing, so the database type is not known. Add it with a line like: dialect = postgres" >&2; exit 1; elif grep -Eqs '^dialect *= *postgres' .sqlfluff; then squawk migrations/*.sql; else echo 'squawk: not run, the database is not Postgres (dialect in .sqlfluff)'; fi
checks.protects: Postgres migrations that would lock a live table or break running code, such as a new required column.
checks.misses: Every database but Postgres, and migration files outside the migrations/ folder.

checks.name: sql migrations
checks.run: echo 'Fill in this check: a command that applies every migration to an empty test database' >&2; exit 1
checks.protects: Every migration file runs, in order, on an empty database; fill in the project's command.
checks.misses: Problems that show only with real data or a live database.

switchOffs.what: noqa comment switches off a SQLFluff rule
squawk-ignore switches off a Squawk rule
